status: design selection; not runtime unit definitions
era_semantics: Featured era is a production/gameplay grouping, not an invention date or exclusive unlock. Preserve source horizons and capability gates.

eras.name: First war parties
eras.design_rationale: Introduce melee, thrown weapons, and scouting with small bands.

eras.name: Settled villages
eras.design_rationale: Add settlement defense, cheap ranged troops, waterways, and supply range.

eras.name: Bronze Age states
eras.design_rationale: Give early states organized infantry, elite guards, chariots, and siege logistics.

eras.name: Early Iron Age
eras.design_rationale: Introduce mobile screening, mounted ranged attacks, desert mobility, and naval ramming.

eras.name: Classical systems
eras.design_rationale: Support competing infantry doctrines, regional ranged weapons, elephants, and organized engineering.

eras.name: Late antique systems
eras.design_rationale: Emphasize armored cavalry, defensive infantry, fortifications, and regional fleets.

eras.name: High medieval networks
eras.design_rationale: Offer different mounted and ranged traditions alongside siege engines and contrasting ship families.

eras.name: Late medieval transition
eras.design_rationale: Add anti-cavalry blocks, armored foot troops, regional shock infantry, and early gunpowder.

eras.name: Pike and shot
eras.design_rationale: Combine firearm infantry, protective pikes, pistol cavalry, ocean fleets, and siege specialists.

eras.name: Flintlock armies
eras.design_rationale: Establish line battles, assault infantry, versatile cavalry, and separate naval battle and patrol roles.

eras.name: Revolutionary mass war
eras.design_rationale: Distinguish assault columns, dispersed marksmen, heavy and light cavalry, mobile guns, and river crossings.

eras.name: Rifle steam and telegraph
eras.design_rationale: Make range, steam power, rail supply, communications, and casualty recovery meaningful.

eras.name: High industrial warfare
eras.design_rationale: Introduce sustained automatic fire, rapid artillery, armored scouts, and asymmetric naval threats.

eras.name: First World War
eras.design_rationale: Cover trenches, assault teams, indirect fire, early armor, aerial reconnaissance, and undersea warfare.

eras.name: Mechanized combined arms
eras.design_rationale: Build interdependent armor, infantry, anti-armor, aviation, amphibious operations, and recovery.

eras.name: Cold War
eras.design_rationale: Add mechanized infantry, guided weapons, mobile fires, helicopters, missile fleets, and electronic support.

eras.name: Precision expeditionary warfare
eras.design_rationale: Focus on reconnaissance, deployability, precision fires, persistent air support, and sea-based deployment.

eras.name: Contested multi-domain warfare
eras.design_rationale: Pair drone reconnaissance and attack with counter-drone defense, remote vehicles, and exposed-route resupply.
